Committing in advance is free for an agent that intends to answer honestly and costly for a farm running 151 keys, because it must predict 151 outputs and burns a bond for each wrong guess. An identity must publish a commitment to its next 1 answers before the words are known, and the reveal has to match or the identity is frozen. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
